```{r}
library(tabr)
library(tidyverse)

movable_do <- function(solfege_str, key = "C", octave = 3) {
  # offsets in semitones relative to Do
  solfege_tbl <- tribble(
    ~syllable, ~note,
    "do",      "c",
    "di",      "c#",
    "ra",      "d_",
    "re",      "d",
    "ri",      "d#",
    "me",      "e_",
    "mi",      "e",
    "fa",      "f",
    "fi",      "f#",
    "se",      "g_",
    "sol",     "g",
    "so",      "g",
    "si",      "g#",
    "le",      "a_",
    "la",      "a",
    "li",      "a#",
    "te",      "b_",
    "ti",      "b",
    "r",       "r"
  )
  
  # Extract the tonic from the key 
  tonic <- tolower(sub("m$", "", key))
  key_offsets <- c(
    "c" = 0,
    "c#" = 1, "d_" = 1,
    "d" = 2, 
    "d#" = 3, "e_" = 3,
    "e" = 4, 
    "f" = 5,
    "f#" = 6, "g_" = 6,
    "g" = 7, 
    "g#" = 8, "a_" = 8,
    "a" = 9, 
    "a#" = 10, "b_" = 10,
    "b" = 11
  )
  
  is_minor <- grepl("m$", tolower(key))
  shift <- key_offsets[tonic]
  if (is.na(shift)) stop("Invalid key. Use tabr format like 'g', 'b_', 'f#', or 'am'.")
  
  # la-based minor: do sits on the relative major (3 half steps above the minor tonic)
  if (is_minor) shift <- (shift + 3) %% 12
  
  oct_diff <- octave - 3
  base_oct <- if (oct_diff > 0) {
    strrep("'", oct_diff)
  } else if (oct_diff < 0) {
    strrep(",", abs(oct_diff))
  } else {
    ""
  }
  
  notes_tbl <- tibble(token = str_split_1(str_squish(solfege_str), " ")) |>
    separate_wider_regex(
      token,
      patterns = c(syllable = "[a-zA-Z]+", extra_oct = ".*")
    ) |>
    mutate(syllable = str_to_lower(syllable)) |>
    left_join(solfege_tbl, by = "syllable")
  
  if (any(is.na(notes_tbl$note))) {
    bad <- unique(notes_tbl$syllable[is.na(notes_tbl$note)])
    stop("Unknown syllable(s): ", paste(bad, collapse = ", "))
  }
  
  converted_str <- notes_tbl |>
    mutate(full_note = if_else(note == "r",
                               str_c("r", extra_oct),
                               str_c(note, base_oct, extra_oct))) |>
    pull(full_note) |>
    str_c(collapse = " ")
  
  # Build string in C Major based off of solfege then transpose it 
  nw <- as_noteworthy(converted_str)
  if (shift > 0) {
    nw <- transpose(nw, shift, key = key)
  }
  
  return(nw)
}
```

# Belltone #1

**Major Pentascale + Triad**
```{r}
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 1.4
#| out-width: "90%"

c_major_pentascale <- movable_do("do re mi fa so fa mi re do", key = "c", octave = 4) |>
  as_music(info = "4*8 2", key = "c", time = "4/4", tempo = "4 = 90")

c_major_triad <- movable_do("do mi so mi do", key = "c", octave = 4) |>
  as_music(info = "4*4 2", key = "c", time = "4/4", tempo = "4 = 90")

major_belltone1 <- c(c_major_pentascale, c_major_triad)

plot_music(major_belltone1, clef = "treble")
```


**Bridge**
```{r}
#| fig-width: 2.5
#| fig-height: 2
#| out-width: "32%"

bridge <- movable_do("do' ti la", key = "am", octave = 3) |>
  as_music(info = "4*2 2", key = "am", time = "4/4", tempo = "4 = 90")

plot_music(bridge, clef = "treble")
```

**Minor Pentascale + Triad**
```{r}
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 2
#| out-width: "90%"

a_minor_pentascale <- movable_do("la ti do' re' mi' re' do' ti la", key = "am", octave = 3) |>
  as_music(info = "4*8 2", key = "am", time = "4/4", tempo = "4 = 90")

a_minor_triad <- movable_do("la do' mi' do' la", key = "am", octave = 3) |>
  as_music(info = "4*4 2", key = "am", time = "4/4", tempo = "4 = 90")

minor_belltone1 <- c(a_minor_pentascale, a_minor_triad)

plot_music(minor_belltone1, clef = "treble")
```
